records.method: Example B (tvui 0.2.1/0.2.2) perf log, 300-frame windows over ~90 s of use and 45 s idle
records.evidence: frame interval avg 16.66-16.84 ms with 186-209 views, 3-50 draw calls, 200-840 quads, 12-14 image textures; swap avg 1.1-1.4 ms (the vsync wait happens in the first GL call of the next frame, not in SDL_GL_SwapWindow)
records.limitations: 4-14 intervals per 300 exceed 20 ms even when idle; the average implies only ~1-2 truly dropped frames per 300, the rest is jitter made up by the next frame. Occasional 25-52 ms stalls inside SDL_PollEvent, cause unknown. Replacing a full-screen quad with a clear made no measurable difference.
